questions.question_text: Panchviṣhay chhe te to pūrve dev-manuṣhyādikne viṣhe _______ dehe karīne āpaṇe jīve bhogavyā chhe to paṇ hajī lagaṇ e viṣhaynī _______ thaī nathī.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma.47 states: 'Panchviṣhay chhe te to pūrve dev-manuṣhyādikne viṣhe anant dehe karīne āpaṇe jīve bhogavyā chhe to paṇ hajī lagaṇ e viṣhaynī tṛupti thaī nathī'.

questions.question_text: Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene ________ karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma.47 states: 'Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene pāṇīe karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.Ma.47 pramāṇe, `bhagwānnā bhakta thaīne varṣh ke be varṣh ke pānch varṣh viṣhay bhogavīne pūrṇa thavāshe nahī` kem?
options: Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene pāṇīe karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī, tem indriyo chhe tene kyārey viṣhay thakī tṛupti thaī nathī ne thashe paṇ nahī.
Kāraṇ ke bhakta hoy tene kyārey viṣhay bhogavā na joīe.
Kāraṇ ke dev-manuṣhyādikne paṇ viṣhay nī tṛupti na thay.
Kāraṇ ke viṣhay nī tṛupti mātra bhagwān mā ja chhe.
questions.correct_answer: Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene pāṇīe karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī, tem indriyo chhe tene kyārey viṣhay thakī tṛupti thaī nathī ne thashe paṇ nahī.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma.47 explains the reason with the analogy: 'Jem pātāḷ sudhī pṛuthvī fāṭī hoy tene pāṇīe karīne bharvā mānḍīe te kyārey bharāy nahī, tem indriyo chhe tene kyārey viṣhay thakī tṛupti thaī nathī ne thashe paṇ nahī'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.38 pramāṇe, kayā ek `vānā` thakī jīvte ne marīne paṇ sukh kyārey thāy nahī?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.An.38 lists 'Ek dravyādikno lobh' as one of the six things that prevent happiness.

questions.question_text: Ek dravyādikno lobh tathā strīne viṣhe beṭhā-ūṭhyānī vāsanā tathā rasne viṣhe _________ āsakti tathā dehābhimān tathā __________ het rahī jāy tathā sambandhīmā het hoy.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.An.38 states: 'rasne viṣhe jihvānī āsakti tathā dehābhimān tathā kusangīmā het rahī jāy'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.38 pramāṇe, jene `ek dravyādikno lobh` jevā `chha vānā` hoy tene shu thāy chhe?
options: tene koī divas jīvte ne marīne paṇ sukh to kyārey thāy ja nahī
tene mātra jīvte sukh thāy chhe
questions.correct_answer: tene koī divas jīvte ne marīne paṇ sukh to kyārey thāy ja nahī
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.An.38 states: 'e chha vānā jene hoy tene koī divas jīvte ne marīne paṇ sukh to kyārey thāy ja nahī'.

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.38 pramāṇe, nīche āpel mānthī kayī vastu `chha vānā` mānthī ek nathī?
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.An.38 lists 'Dehābhimān', 'kusangīmā het', and 'strīne viṣhe beṭhā-ūṭhyānī vāsanā' as part of the `chha vānā`, but 'bhagwān mā prīti' is not listed.

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.2/993 pramāṇe, `Viṣhayno sambandh thayā morya to ________ peṭhe bīvu ne sambandh thaī jāy to tyā ________ thāvu`.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 2/993 states: 'Viṣhayno sambandh thayā morya to bakarānī peṭhe bīvu ne sambandh thaī jāy to tyā sinh thāvu'.

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.2/993 pramāṇe, `viṣhayno sambandh thayā morya` kevu vartavu joīe?
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 2/993 instructs: 'Viṣhayno sambandh thayā morya to bakarānī peṭhe bīvu'.

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.2/993 pramāṇe, `viṣhayno sambandh thaī jāy` to kevu thāvu joīe?
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato 2/993 instructs: 'ne sambandh thaī jāy to tyā sinh thāvu'.
